plugins/jeetvbe/desktop/php/jeetvbe.php.Aucune TV. Cliquez sur « Ajouter une TV: No TV yet. Click "Add a TV", save, then enter the URL and the key in the Jeedom TV app.
plugins/jeetvbe/desktop/php/jeetvbe.php.Une TV désactivée est refusée par l'API: A disabled TV is refused by the API (401): it can no longer read or control anything.
plugins/jeetvbe/desktop/php/jeetvbe.php.Ajoute à la fin une page « Scénarios » a: Adds a "Scénarios" page at the end, with one tile per active scenario of this group, sorted by name, kept up to date without saving again. Confirmation is asked if the scenario description contains [confirmer], or if its name contains portail, garage, verrou, alarme or panique.
plugins/jeetvbe/desktop/php/jeetvbe.php.Ordres de Jeedom vers la TV: Orders from Jeedom to the TV
plugins/jeetvbe/desktop/php/jeetvbe.php.Durée pendant laquelle une page demandée: How long a page requested by "Afficher …" stays on screen before going back to the previous screen (unless the remote was used). 0 = no return. An order not received by the TV within 60 s is dropped.
plugins/jeetvbe/desktop/php/jeetvbe.php.Ce qu'il faut donner à la TV: What to give to the TV
plugins/jeetvbe/desktop/php/jeetvbe.php.La clé est propre à cette TV et ne donne: The key belongs to this TV and only gives access to the tiles of its pages. Regenerating the key immediately cuts off the TV that used the old one.
plugins/jeetvbe/desktop/php/jeetvbe.php.Tuiles déduites des types génériques des: Tiles derived from the generic types of the enabled devices of the checked objects (lights, shutters, set-points, temperatures, plugs). Pages are appended, to be reviewed before saving.
plugins/jeetvbe/desktop/php/jeetvbe.php.par type (Lumières, Volets, Chauffage et: by type (Lights, Shutters, Heating and A/C, Temperatures, Plugs), tiles named "Room · Name"
plugins/jeetvbe/desktop/php/jeetvbe.php.Les identifiants (p1, t1…) sont attribué: Identifiers (p1, t1…) are assigned on save and stay stable: the TV uses them to designate a tile. Changes only reach the TV after "Save".
plugins/jeetvbe/desktop/php/jeetvbe.php.Les commandes sont créées et tenues à jo: Commands are created and kept up to date by the plugin on every save: one "Afficher <page>" command per page, renamed or deleted with it.
plugins/jeetvbe/desktop/php/jeetvbe.php.La touche de couleur de la télécommande: The remote's colour key opens the chosen page, on top of any app (the app's accessibility service must be enabled once). The same key, or Back, closes it. A deleted page frees its key. A newly added page only shows up in these lists after "Save".
plugins/jeetvbe/desktop/php/jeetvbe.php.Jusqu'à 6 infos affichées en permanence: Up to 6 infos always shown at the top of the TV screen (pages and panel), updated live: an info command, a short label (24 characters at most) and an icon.
plugins/jeetvbe/desktop/php/jeetvbe.php.Afficher la barre sur la TV, par-dessus: Show the bar on the TV, on top of every app
plugins/jeetvbe/desktop/php/jeetvbe.php.Arrondi : nombre de décimales (vide = va: Rounding: number of decimals (empty = value as is)
plugins/jeetvbe/desktop/php/jeetvbe.php.Des indicateurs qui s'affichent et se re: Indicators that show and hide by themselves, from info commands, without any scenario (same model as the TvOverlay plugin's automatic indicators). The plugin recomputes the bar whenever a cited command changes, and only sends it to the TV when what is displayed changes. "Indicateur (JSON)" adds temporary indicators, "Retirer un indicateur" removes them.
plugins/jeetvbe/desktop/php/jeetvbe.php.Icône Material Design fixe ; avec une co: Fixed Material Design icon; with a command, fallback icon until it has published something
plugins/jeetvbe/desktop/php/jeetvbe.php.Un nom pour chaque flux de caméra (RTSP,: A name for each camera stream (RTSP, HLS): [video=doorbell] in Message or Question, or "video":"doorbell" in Notifier (JSON), plays this stream on the TV. The full address, credentials included, is kept by the plugin and is never shown nor logged again. A source is saved immediately (no "Save" needed). Same name: the address is replaced.
plugins/jeetvbe/desktop/php/jeetvbe.php.Les commandes de l'équipement « Toutes l: Commands of the "Toutes les TV" device reach this TV: notifications when it is online with the screen on, temporary indicators always. Uncheck for a test TV.
plugins/jeetvbe/desktop/php/jeetvbe.php.« Toutes les TV » n'est pas une TV : ses: "Toutes les TV" is not a TV: its commands (Message, Notifier (JSON), Retirer une notification, Indicateur (JSON), Retirer un indicateur, Question) are replayed on every TV that receives broadcasts. A notification only goes to TVs online with the screen on; a temporary indicator goes to all. Video sources are each TV's own: a TV without the source gets the notification without video. Question (Ask block): asked on every TV that is on, the first answer wins and the question closes on the others.
plugins/jeetvbe/desktop/php/jeetvbe.php.Pages, bandeau, touches de couleur, barr: Pages, banner, colour keys, status bar and indicators; never the key, video sources, broadcast option or name
plugins/jeetvbe/desktop/php/jeetvbe.php.Une page « Tableau des trains » affiche: A "Train board" page shows the next departures of one to three routes of the SNCB/NMBS plugin, like a station departure board. A "hidden" page appears neither in the tabs nor in the navigation of the TV: only its "Afficher" command (for example "Afficher Trains") and a colour key open it.

plugins/jeetvbe/desktop/js/jeetvbe.js.Un volet n\\'a de position (min/max) que: A shutter only has a position (min/max) if it has a "Set" command. Empty: 0–100, step 10.
plugins/jeetvbe/desktop/js/jeetvbe.js.Vide : les bornes de la commande « Régle: Empty: the bounds of the "Set" command, otherwise 0–100, step 1. The value sent is clamped to [min, max].
plugins/jeetvbe/desktop/js/jeetvbe.js.Aucune page. Ajoutez-en une, ou générez-: No page. Add one, or generate them from generic types.
plugins/jeetvbe/desktop/js/jeetvbe.js.Supprimer cette page et ses tuiles ?: Delete this page and its tiles?
plugins/jeetvbe/desktop/js/jeetvbe.js.Enregistrez d\\'abord la TV : la clé est: Save the TV first: the key is generated on save.
plugins/jeetvbe/desktop/js/jeetvbe.js.Régénérer la clé ? La TV qui utilise l\\: Regenerate the key? The TV using the old one will be cut off immediately.
plugins/jeetvbe/desktop/js/jeetvbe.js.Choisissez la commande à exécuter. L\\'é: Choose the command to run. The state is optional: without it, the TV shows ▶.
plugins/jeetvbe/desktop/js/jeetvbe.js.Régler : une commande action de type lis: Set: a list (select) action command. The choices offered on the TV are its list values, re-read on every load. State is optional.
plugins/jeetvbe/desktop/js/jeetvbe.js.Aucun scénario choisi : la tuile ne fera: No scenario chosen: the tile will do nothing on the TV.
plugins/jeetvbe/desktop/js/jeetvbe.js.Aucune commande choisie : la tuile ne fe: No command chosen: the tile will do nothing on the TV.
plugins/jeetvbe/desktop/js/jeetvbe.js.Remplacer les indicateurs de cette TV pa: Replace this TV's indicators with TvOverlay's?
plugins/jeetvbe/desktop/js/jeetvbe.js.indicateur(s) importé(s). Relisez, puis: indicator(s) imported. Review, then save. TvOverlay is not modified.
plugins/jeetvbe/desktop/js/jeetvbe.js.Remplacer les pages, le bandeau, les tou: Replace this TV's pages, banner, colour keys, status bar and indicators with the chosen TV's? (nothing is saved before "Save")
plugins/jeetvbe/desktop/js/jeetvbe.js.Copie chargée. Relisez, puis sauvegardez: Copy loaded. Review, then save: colour keys follow the pages by name.
plugins/jeetvbe/desktop/js/jeetvbe.js.Aucun trajet : ajoutez-en un (trois au p: No route: add one (three at most).
plugins/jeetvbe/desktop/js/jeetvbe.js.Aucun trajet choisi : cette ligne ne ser: No route chosen: this line will not be saved.
plugins/jeetvbe/desktop/js/jeetvbe.js.Aucun trajet dans le plugin SNCB/NMBS :: No route in the SNCB/NMBS plugin: create one first.
plugins/jeetvbe/desktop/js/jeetvbe.js.Le plugin SNCB/NMBS n\\'est pas installé: The SNCB/NMBS plugin is not installed or not active: the board will show "timetable unavailable".
plugins/jeetvbe/desktop/js/jeetvbe.js.Ni onglet ni navigation sur la TV : seul: No tab and no navigation on the TV: only the Afficher command and a colour key open it
plugins/jeetvbe/desktop/js/jeetvbe.js.Un tableau des trains n\\'a pas de tuile: A train board has no tiles: the tiles of this page will be removed on save (switching back to "Tiles" before saving keeps them). Continue?

plugins/jeetvbe/core/ajax/jeetvbe.ajax.p.TV introuvable : enregistrez d'abord l'é: TV not found: save the device first

plugins/jeetvbe/core/class/jeetvbe.class.Durée invalide : nombre de secondes atte: Invalid duration: number of seconds expected (empty = default duration, 0 = no return)
plugins/jeetvbe/core/class/jeetvbe.class.Adresse invalide : rtsp://, rtsps://, ht: Invalid address: rtsp://, rtsps://, http:// or https:// expected.
plugins/jeetvbe/core/class/jeetvbe.class.Indiquez l'identifiant (id) de l'indicat: Give the indicator identifier (id) in the message.
plugins/jeetvbe/core/class/jeetvbe.class.Indiquez l'identifiant (id) de la notifi: Give the notification identifier (id) in the message.
plugins/jeetvbe/core/class/jeetvbe.class.Le message doit être un objet JSON, par: The message must be a JSON object, for example
plugins/jeetvbe/core/class/jeetvbe.class.Nom de source invalide : lettres, chiffr: Invalid source name: letters, digits, "_", "-" or ".", 32 characters at most.

plugins/jeetvbe/plugin_info/configuratio.Le plugin n'a pas de réglage global : ch: The plugin has no global setting: each TV is a device, with its own key and pages. The API URL and the key are shown on the device page.
plugins/jeetvbe/plugin_info/configuratio.Chaque TV est un équipement, avec sa pro: Each TV is a device, with its own key and pages. The API URL and the key are shown on the device page.
plugins/jeetvbe/plugin_info/configuratio.Une image jointe ([image=…], files, Noti: An attached image ([image=…], files, Notifier (JSON)) is only accepted from a plugin's data/ folder, Jeedom's data/ folder or its temporary folder. Add other folders here, one absolute path per line.
